arxiv-2011-08730.title: Sum-frequency excitation of coherent magnons
arxiv-2011-08730.creator: Dominik M. Juraschek, Derek S. Wang, Prineha Narang
arxiv-2011-08730.description: Abstract Coherent excitation of magnons is conventionally achieved through Raman scattering processes, in which the difference-frequency components of the driving field are resonant with the magnon energy. Here, we describe mechanisms by which the sum-frequency components of the driving field can be used to coherently excite magnons through two-particle absorption processes.

arxiv-2203-00074.title: How Well Can We Measure Galaxy Dust Attenuation Curves? The Impact of the Assumed Star-Dust Geometry Model in SED Fitting
arxiv-2203-00074.creator: Sidney Lower, Desika Narayanan, Joel Leja, Benjamin D. Johnson, Charlie Conroy, Romeel Davé
arxiv-2203-00074.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Sidney Lower, Desika Narayanan, Joel Leja, Benjamin D. Johnson, Charlie Conroy, Romeel Davé. One of the most common methods for inferring galaxy attenuation curves is via spectral energy distribution (SED) modeling, where the dust attenuation properties are modeled simultaneously with other galaxy physical properties. In this paper, we assess the ability of SED modeling to infer these dust attenuation curves from broadband photometry, and suggest a new flexible model that greatly improves the accuracy of attenuation curve derivations.

arxiv-2208-08543.title: On the Relationship between CH 3 ​ OD \text{CH}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\smash[t]{\text{3}}}\text{OD} Abundance and Temperature in the Orion KL Nebula
arxiv-2208-08543.creator: Olivia H. Wilkins, Geoffrey A. Blake
arxiv-2208-08543.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Olivia H. Wilkins, Geoffrey A. Blake. The relative abundances of singly-deuterated methanol isotopologues, [ CH 2 ​ DOH \text{CH}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\smash[t]{\text{2}}}\text{DOH} ]/[ CH 3 ​ OD \text{CH}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\smash[t]{\text{3}}}\text{OD} ] , in star-forming regions deviate from the statistically expected ratio of 3. In Orion KL, the nearest high-mass star-forming region to Earth, the singly-deuterated methanol ratio is about 1, and the cause for this observation has been explored through theory for nearly three decades.

arxiv-2303-00185.title: Rashba spin-orbit coupling enhanced magnetoresistance in junctions with one ferromagnet
arxiv-2303-00185.creator: Chenghao Shen, Ranran Cai, Alex Matos-Abiague, Wei Han, Jong E. Han, Igor Žutić
arxiv-2303-00185.description: Abstract We explain how Rashba spin-orbit coupling (SOC) in a two-dimensional electron gas (2DEG), or in a conventional s s -wave superconductor, can lead to a large magnetoresistance even with one ferromagnet. However, such enhanced magnetoresistance is not generic and can be nonmonotonic and change its sign with Rashba SOC.

arxiv-2305-05698.title: Characterizing cool, neutral gas and ionized metals in the outskirts of low- z z galaxy clusters Characterizing cool, neutral gas and ionized metals in the outskirts of low- z z galaxy clusters – A3 2021
arxiv-2305-05698.creator: Sapna Mishra, Sowgat Muzahid, Sayak Dutta, Raghunathan Srianand, and Jane Charlton
arxiv-2305-05698.description: Abstract We present the first detection of cool, neutral gas in the outskirts of low- z z galaxy clusters using a statistically significant sample of 3191 z ≈ 0.2 z\approx 0.2 background quasar–foreground cluster pairs by cross-matching the Hubble Spectroscopic Legacy Archive quasar catalog with optically- and SZ-selected cluster catalogs.

arxiv-2305-14036.title: Robust Fault Estimators for Nonlinear Systems: An Ultra-Local Model Design Thanks: 1. Department of Mechanical Engineering, Eindhoven University of Technology, The Netherlands Thanks: 2. Delft Center for Systems and Control, Delft University of Technology, The Netherlands
arxiv-2305-14036.creator: Farhad Ghanipoor 1 , Carlos Murguia 1 , Peyman Mohajerin Esfahani 2 , Nathan van de Wouw 1
arxiv-2305-14036.description: Abstract . This paper proposes a nonlinear estimator for the robust reconstruction of process and sensor faults for a class of uncertain nonlinear systems. The proposed fault estimation method augments the system dynamics with an ultra-local (in time) internal state-space representation (a finite chain of integrators) of the fault vector.

arxiv-2402-14793.title: Adaptive hybrid density functionals
arxiv-2402-14793.creator: Danish Khan, Alastair J. A. Price, Maximillian L. Ach, O. Anatole von Lilienfeld
arxiv-2402-14793.description: Abstract Abstract Exact exchange contributions are known to crucially affect electronic states, which in turn govern covalent bond formation and breaking in chemical species. Empirically averaging the exact exchange admixture over compositional degrees of freedom, hybrid density functional approximations have been widely successful, yet have fallen short to reach high level quantum chemistry accuracy, primarily due to delocalization errors.

arxiv-2407-04173.title: Quantifying Prediction Consistency Under Fine-Tuning Multiplicity in Tabular LLMs
arxiv-2407-04173.creator: Faisal Hamman, Pasan Dissanayake, Saumitra Mishra, Freddy Lecue, Sanghamitra Dutta
arxiv-2407-04173.description: Abstract Fine-tuning LLMs on tabular classification tasks can lead to the phenomenon of fine-tuning multiplicity where equally well-performing models make conflicting predictions on the same input. Fine-tuning multiplicity can arise due to variations in the training process, e.g., seed, weight initialization, minor changes to training data, etc.

arxiv-2408-15990.title: A Control Theoretic Approach to Simultaneously Estimate Average Value of Time and Determine Dynamic Price for High-occupancy Toll Lanes
arxiv-2408-15990.creator: Xuting Wang, Wen-Long Jin, Yafeng Yin
arxiv-2408-15990.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Xuting Wang, Wen-Long Jin, Yafeng Yin. The dynamic pricing problem of a freeway corridor with high-occupancy toll (HOT) lanes was formulated and solved based on a point queue abstraction of the traffic system Yin and Lou, (2009) . However, existing pricing strategies cannot guarantee that the closed-loop system converges to the optimal state, in which the HOT lanes’ capacity is fully utilized but there is no queue on the HOT lanes, and a well-behaved estimation and control method is quite challenging and still elusive.

arxiv-2411-12852.title: Enhanced Cross-Dataset Electroencephalogram-based Emotion Recognition using Unsupervised Domain Adaptation
arxiv-2411-12852.creator: Md Niaz Imtiaz, Naimul Khan
arxiv-2411-12852.description: Abstract Emotion recognition holds great promise in healthcare and in the development of affect-sensitive systems such as brain-computer interfaces (BCIs). However, the high cost of labeled data and significant differences in electroencephalogram (EEG) signals among individuals limit the cross-domain application of EEG-based emotion recognition models.

arxiv-2506-00177.title: Creation of a degenerate Bose-Bose mixture of erbium and lithium atoms
arxiv-2506-00177.creator: Jasmine Kalia, Jared Rivera, Rubaiya R. Emran, William J. Solorio Hernandez, Kiryang Kwon, Richard J. Fletcher
arxiv-2506-00177.description: Abstract We report the realization of a degenerate mixture of 166 Er and 7 Li atoms in their lowest spin state. The two species are sequentially laser-cooled and loaded into an optical dipole trap, then transported to a glass cell in which further cooling to degeneracy occurs.

arxiv-2509-15293.title: How Good are Foundation Models in Step-by-Step Embodied Reasoning?
arxiv-2509-15293.creator: Dinura Dissanayake 1 , Ahmed Heakl 1 , Omkar Thawakar 1 , Noor Ahsan 1 , Ritesh Thawkar 1 , Ketan More 1 , Jean Lahoud 1 , Rao Anwer 1 , Hisham Cholakkal 1 , Ivan Laptev 1 , Fahad Khan 1, 2 , Salman Khan 1, 3 1 Mohamed bin Zayed University of AI, 2 Linköping University, 3 Australian National Univers
arxiv-2509-15293.description: Abstract Embodied agents operating in the physical world must make decisions that are not only effective but also safe, spatially coherent, and grounded in context. While recent advances in large multimodal models (LMMs) have shown promising capabilities in visual understanding and language generation, their ability to perform structured reasoning for real-world embodied tasks remains underexplored.

pmc-13055687.title: Poststroke Dementia: The Rotterdam Study Shows Why Risk Factors, Stroke Severity, and Premorbid Brain Health Matter
pmc-13055687.creator: Michelle C Johansen, Rebecca F Gottesman
pmc-13055687.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). al to cognitive longevity. Progress has been hampered by lack of standardized cognitive measures, selection bias as to who was enrolled, assessments conducted too close to the index event (when delirium, depression, aphasia, and early recovery confound performance), and limited characterization of premorbid cognition and vascular risk.
